name: 시나리오 1 합성(composed)
source: frame references copy only the recorded VLM observation values. Positions, chronology, food, gaze, seat, device inputs and model responses are composed. No photos or transcripts. Every photo row follows the VLM timing: at is the capture time and the answer arrives lag ms later (1.5-2.0 s; measured average nano 1.6 s, mini 1.8 s). After the first answer the TV rule watches, so photos are 1 s apart (2 s after a manual off). Eye and PAM rows come after the commands they answer. The left row is when the viewer actually leaves.
